purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: An official government organization chart identifies the Malegaon land-record office, and the state department documents city-survey/property-card and e-map functions. The BhuNaksha viewer presents parcel-number/plot-info workflows; no plot was selected and no property record was queried.
registryAssessment: Maharashtra’s official RTI organization chart lists the District Superintendent of Land Records, Nashik No. 2 at Malegaon. The state Land Records Department describes the city-survey/property-card and map functions, and the official Malegaon Municipal Corporation site identifies the local planning authority. Together these establish a local land-record office/function; they do not establish a safe public geometry endpoint.
